visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a ponytail, wearing a beige long-sleeved tight athletic top and matching leggings with pink socks, lies prone on a Reformer long box. She holds straps and extends her arms backwards. The studio environment features light wood floors and large mirrors reflecting Pilates equipment and soft overhead lighting. (2) The woman transitions to a kneeling plank position on the Reformer carriage. She maintains a straight back with her forearms resting on a padded box, showing controlled core engagement. (3) She performs a full plank on the Reformer, extending her legs straight back with toes tucked against the shoulder blocks while maintaining forearm support. (4) The scene shifts to the woman performing a standing lunge. One foot is on the floor and the other is on the moving Reformer carriage, demonstrating balance and leg strength in the brightly lit studio. (5) She executes a lunge variation on a different Reformer machine, leaning her torso forward and back with hands on her hips to increase the stretch. (6) Standing with a wide stance, she performs a side lunge stretch, sliding the Reformer carriage outwards with one leg while keeping her core stable. (7) Finally, she lies supine over a Pilates arc/spine corrector, performing slow, overhead arm circles and spinal articulation, focusing on flexibility and breath.
